value.rationale: Sharp quantitative stability is a natural missing invariant after the recent qualitative dual exposed-point theorem. The result identifies the correct dual-slice sensitivity exponent, has an exact dimension-independent constant, and detects a genuine phase/off-diagonal coupling transition at p=2. It applies to arbitrary dual-ball functionals, not only pure states, so it is not a numerical curiosity or restatement of an isolated rank-one calculation.
